title: Stop or Clarify? Experience-Conditioned Active Fact Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.34941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fact-verification benchmarks score the final label, while an interactive verifier must first decide whether the available evidence is sufficient. We focus on that intermediate Stop-or-Clarify Decision. Uncertainty alone is insufficient, because the benefit of another evidence-acquisition step is unknown before the step is taken. Sequential Experience-Adaptive Clarification (SEAC) wraps a fixed verifier with a lightweight evidence-acquisition policy. For each claim, SEAC retrieves evidence, runs the verifier, forms a label-free decision state, and combines stop risk with an observational clarification-utility estimate from earlier executed trajectories. Clarification is requested only when this score exceeds the action cost and decision threshold. On SciFact, LIAR, and FEVER, SEAC improves mean accuracy and macro-F1 over the compared fact-verification and active-retrieval baselines. Equal-budget and formula-level diagnostics support selec

translated_title: 停止还是澄清？基于经验条件的主动事实核查
translated_abstract: 事实核查基准通常只对最终标签进行评分，而交互式核查系统必须首先判断现有证据是否已经充分。我们聚焦于这一中间环节——“停止还是澄清”决策。仅凭不确定性是不够的，因为在执行下一次证据获取步骤之前，无法预知该步骤的收益。序列经验自适应澄清（SEAC）用一个轻量级的证据获取策略来包装固定的核查器。对于每个声明，SEAC 检索证据、运行核查器、构建无标签的决策状态，并将停止风险与基于先前已执行轨迹得到的观察性澄清效用估计相结合。只有当该分数超过动作成本和决策阈值时，才请求进一步的澄清。在 SciFact、LIAR 和 FEVER 数据集上，SEAC 在平均准确率和宏 F1 指标上均优于所对比的事实核查与主动检索基线方法。等预算实验和公式级诊断支持该方法的优越性。
tldr: 提出 SEAC 框架，通过经验条件化的“停止还是澄清”决策机制，在交互式事实核查中自适应判断证据是否充分并决定是否获取更多证据，在 SciFact、LIAR 和 FEVER 上显著超越现有事实核查与主动检索基线方法。
en_tdlr: SEAC introduces an experience-conditioned stop-or-clarify decision mechanism that adaptively determines whether available evidence suffices in interactive fact verification, outperforming fact-verification and active-retrieval baselines on SciFact, LIAR, and FEVER.
